content.title: Where to watch the Golden State Warriors vs. Los Angeles Clippers NBA play-in game free stream
content.text: Golden State Warriors guard Stephen Curry (30) drives against Los Angeles Clippers guard Bogdan Bogdanovic (7) during the second half of an NBA basketball game, Sunday, April 12, 2026, in Inglewood, Calif. (AP Photo/Ethan Swope)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Jenna Malinowski | JMalinowski@mlive.comThe Golden State Warriors and the Los Angeles Clippers will face off tonight in the NBA play-in tournament.Fans can catch the action exclusively on Amazon Prime Video at 10 p.m. ET. New customers can start with a 30-day free trial and score access to exclusive sports content as well as hit TV shows and movies. The Warriors finished 10th overall in the Western Conference with a 37-45 record, while the Clippers finished ninth with a 42-40 record. The two teams met four times during the regular season, with the Clippers winning three out of four games. The winner of tonight’s game will advance to play the Phoenix Suns for the right to the No. 8 seed and to take on the Oklahoma City Thunder in the first round of the playoffs. The loser will officially be eliminated from playoff contention.
